name: Air and Ténéré Natural Reserves
description: In northern Niger, this vast reserve spans the volcanic Aïr Mountains, a cool, wetter pocket of Sahel life, and the sand seas of the Ténéré desert beside them. At about 77,000 square kilometres, it is one of Africa's largest protected areas. Dorcas gazelles and Barbary sheep still roam here, but the addax has not been seen in 20 years, and conflict and illegal mining have put the site on the danger list.
